environment.description: Same pipeline plugin deployed on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB) in us-west-2. The ALB has an AWS WAFv2 WebACL (arn:aws:wafv2:us-west-2:123456789012:regional/webacl/cicd-protection/a1b2c3d4) attached with the following rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWS-AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet at priority 100 with SizeRestriction_BODY rule in COUNT mode only, (2) a custom rule group 'cicd-body-inspection' at priority 200 that applies a regex pattern set matching on request body for YAML sequences containing executable paths (pattern: '\[\s*["\x27]?(/bin/|/usr/bin/|sh|bash|curl|wget|python)') with action BLOCK and TextTransformation NONE applied to Body with OversizeHandling MATCH, (3) AWS-AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet at priority 300 in default BLOCK mode. The task runs with a read-only root filesystem and the /tmp/workspace is an ephemeral volume. The task IAM role has no permissions beyond ECR pull and CloudWatch Logs.

waf_rules.name: cicd-body-inspection
waf_rules.description: Regex pattern set on Body field matching YAML array sequences with executable paths

config.network: Private subnet, ALB in public subnet
